import time
from time import perf_counter


def test_a():
    start = time.monotonic()
    work()
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
    assert elapsed < 2.0


def test_b():
    t0 = perf_counter()
    work()
    assert perf_counter() - t0 <= 1


def test_c():
    start = time.time()
    work()
    end = time.time()
    assert 3 > end - start
